text: After this you can subtract an observed count from the required count.
Find how many units fewer were recorded than required.
Inferred: Twelve usable units are required, and only nine are available. How large is the deficit?
Required minus observed gives the deficiency: 12 minus 9 equals 3 units.
A quantity gap can be calculated before identifying its cause.
